body:
Outcome: successful workflow-final-verification, governed-final, on the exact adopted rigorloop-records-v2 change and the 62 engineering subjects recorded below.

Explanation: review policy had several normative owners, so obligations could disappear between assessment, planning and closeout. Review and Closeout now owns the shared policy within Workflow; specialist skills retain methods and load selective portable applications. RC-SR-03 orders overlapping conditions (necessary owner decision, materially incomplete evidence, required actionable corrections, approval), retaining supported findings and allowing optional notes. Plans and routing preserve fresh independent final whole-change Code Review after implementation and before distinct successful Verify. Historical contracts retain their meaning; no schema, primary command, new stage, migration or CLI readiness decision is introduced. The bounded validation-wrapper correction makes existing v2 JSON owners receive complete-set validation instead of fabricated historical YAML selection or a skipped check.

Coherence assessment: pass across requirements, test validity, architecture, lifecycle, implementation completion, validation, generated currency, review closeout and scoped branch safety. The approved proposal, exact two-model Design and amended Delivery plan remain unchanged and applicable. RC-SR-01–18 and WF-SR-16 map through the plan to m1-consumer-scenarios, deterministic packaging/validator regressions and TG-FINAL-1. M1 is complete. M2 is lifecycle closeout only and remains in progress until the separately authorized PR exists. Independent milestone and fresh final whole-change reviews are approved with no findings; the reporter resolved both earlier Design findings. No open blocker exists. The ten retained origin-drift observations preserve original finding subjects and are not drift of the approved current subjects. All current review subjects were compared with current bytes and match.

Proof: bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base 873f0a238ac5d6d240d5920946a882b54f0e4175 --head 078af3756d5d21147e8a7a69455c382fb3e9ef81 --jobs 4 --timeout 900 passed in an actual run. The earlier focused commands and their actual failures, corrections, skips and bounded reruns are retained in m1-focused-validation, including the full adapter-suite metadata failure corrected by regeneration and targeted passing proof. The current generated candidate and all three portable adapter packages were directly validated. Manual assessment checks the guidance's meaning and composed consumer behavior; it is not a runtime policy evaluator or a measured token-savings benchmark. Reuse is limited to passed unaffected surfaces with unchanged procedure/environment; the final integrated checks are fresh. No new contrary evidence arose after final Code Review.

Limits and risk: local validation is not hosted CI. Current candidate metadata remains a local release candidate; no release, merge or installation activation occurred. Historical contracts and roots are preserved. Two baseline historical proposal links in Workflow are not relied on for current authority; the approved current package supplies it. Unrelated docs/design.zip is excluded from the engineering scope and handoff. Shared application drift is checked mechanically, but semantic policy remains a reviewer responsibility. Recover by restoring the coherent consumer set before adoption; after reliance fix forward while preserving original assessment evidence.

Recording and handoff: this report and subsequent attributable evidence/activity/PR-closeout records describe unchanged engineering and do not retarget old subjects. Relevant contrary new evidence still defeats reliance. Successful Verify grants no external permission; the user's separate request to proceed through PR authorizes the next PR activity. No merge, release or destructive action is authorized by this result.

Renewed assessment after public-skill portability correction: success. The user identified internal requirement identifiers in shipped guidance. The two introductory paragraphs and 14 canonical copies now use customer-facing project policy and contract language without internal RC/WF IDs or Design-checkout commentary. Substantive rule bodies and approved proposal/Design/Delivery are unchanged. Maintainer traceability remains in governing repository documents. Current candidate metadata and its existing test hash were regenerated; no historical metadata or published release was changed.

Current verification basis and evidence supersede the earlier engineering-head readiness claim above for this handoff. Fresh affected proof in public-skill-portability-correction covers validate-skills (20 skills), build-skills --check, test-skill-validator (370 pass), the targeted adapter metadata test (pass), all three regenerated adapter archives, and npm test --prefix packages/rigorloop (652 pass, 2 pre-existing skips, 0 fail). Canonical and archive Markdown scans confirm absence of the internal policy IDs and internal-checkout commentary. git diff --check, python scripts/validate-change-metadata.py docs/changes/2026-09-07-unify-review-closeout-policy/change.json and node scripts/validate-record-store.mjs docs/changes/2026-09-07-unify-review-closeout-policy/change.json --revision baa1da618337c9606fc24231d56ecaece529554f pass. The earlier full 18-check PR command remains a pass on its original immutable head, not a claimed run on this correction. Its unchanged model/validator/lifecycle/selector/historical-fixture surfaces have identical authority, procedure, dependencies and environment. Those results are reused only for unaffected surfaces; changed skill/generated/package bytes received fresh proof. No explicit current-state check is replaced by that reuse.

The independent reviewer renewed M1 approval, then performed a distinct fresh final whole-change assessment after M1 closure. Both current records are approved with exact matching engineering subjects and no new finding. Two earlier Design findings remain resolved by their reporter; no open blocker remains. The portability correction does not change the approved scenarios' substantive outcomes, public interfaces, permissions or closeout obligations. This distinct Verify checks the complete chain and the bounded reuse basis, and renews success on the subjects below. PR #175 already exists under user authorization; the next step is its ordinary fast-forward update. Hosted CI passed prior handoff 0a0e06fb72c087d2684491371a6a84869a482540; no hosted result is claimed for this correction. Later attributable recording-only changes preserve applicability only while engineering and relevant evidence remain unchanged.
